harnessDiagnostics.qualificationUse: Excluded; all final matrix cells rerun after harness-only protection
harnessDiagnostics.symptom: Missing commit parents / immutable proposal history unavailable
harnessDiagnostics.cause: The fixture's direct execFileSync Git calls bypassed the existing product withoutAutomaticGitMaintenance guard. Git 2.54 launched overlapping detached geometric repacks while rapid history commits ran.
harnessDiagnostics.correction: Apply the same existing process-local maintenance guard to fixture Git setup, not the measured CLI environment or user/repository configuration.
harnessDiagnostics.regression: 120-commit fixture retains 122 commits and passes fsck; effective setup Git disables maintenance even when repository settings enable it, without modifying those settings or the measured environment.
harnessDiagnostics.productIntegrity: Source clone fsck passed; unreadable fixture history remained refused. No product verification check was weakened.

sameCodeControl.interpretation: Both variants are the same code; differences demonstrate noise and shared Git-fact warming, not gains.
